channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: U.S. review clears V-22 safety concerns
item.description: The US Naval Air Systems Command has released the findings of a comprehensive review into the V-22 Osprey, reaffirming the aircraft’s airworthiness and allowing continued operations across the US Air Force, Marine Corps and Navy. The post U.S. review clears V-22 safety concerns first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: New British cruise missile enters firing trials
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed that Project Brakestop, a new UK cruise missile programme designed for rapid production and scale, has entered live firing trials, as senior defence officials set out a shift toward faster weapons procurement. The post New British cruise missile enters firing trials first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK says General Dynamics currently ‘not in breach’ on Ajax
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has said that General Dynamics is not currently in breach of its contract for the Ajax armoured vehicle programme, despite renewed concerns over safety, vibration issues and operational viability raised in Parliament. The post UK says General Dynamics currently ‘not in breach’ on Ajax first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Ajax probe delays Defence Investment Plan decisions
item.description: Investigations into the Ajax armoured vehicle will shape decisions in the Defence Investment Plan, delaying the long awaited equipment spending document, as ministers await clarity on the troubled programme. The post Ajax probe delays Defence Investment Plan decisions first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK open to Germany joining future fighter project
item.description: The UK has said it remains open to Germany joining the Global Combat Air Programme, as uncertainty deepens around France and Germany’s FCAS fighter project. The post UK open to Germany joining future fighter project first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Warship shoots down drone swarm off UK coast
item.description: A warship of the Royal Netherlands Navy has successfully shot down aerial and surface drone threats during a live-fire exercise off the Welsh coast. The post Warship shoots down drone swarm off UK coast first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Ferguson Marine delays Glen Rosa delivery to late 2026
item.description: Ferguson Marine has announced a further delay to the delivery of the ferry MV Glen Rosa, with the vessel now expected to be fully signed off and handed over in the fourth quarter of 2026. The post Ferguson Marine delays Glen Rosa delivery to late 2026 first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Ferguson Marine sets out reform programme and future vision
item.description: Ferguson Marine said historic issues are now being addressed, with structural reforms and a government-backed modernisation programme reshaping the yard’s future. The post Ferguson Marine sets out reform programme and future vision first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: French nuclear attack submarine arrives in Scotland
item.description: A French Navy Suffren-class nuclear-powered attack submarine has arrived at HM Naval Base Clyde in Scotland. The post French nuclear attack submarine arrives in Scotland first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: HII selected to design and build new US Navy frigate
item.description: HII’s Ingalls Shipbuilding division has been selected by the US Navy to design and build its future small surface combatant, using a derivative of the Legend-class National Security Cutter, after issues with the FREMM design. The post HII selected to design and build new US Navy frigate first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
